query:
-- PERFUMUM RESEARCH AXES (6 axes de recherche)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS perfumum_research_axes (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  axis_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  slug VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  title_fr VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  title_en VARCHAR(255),
  tagline_fr TEXT,
  tagline_en TEXT,
  description_fr TEXT,
  description_en TEXT,
  default_layout VARCHAR(255),
  status ENUM('draft', 'mvp', 'active', 'archived') DEFAULT 'draft',
  color VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '#6366f1',
  icon VARCHAR(50),
  sort_order INT DEFAULT 0,
  kpis JSON,
  ui_modules JSON,
  core_entities JSON,
  default_filters JSON,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX pra_status_idx (status)
);
